text:
elaine (PM): quick design q — should the autoscale control use two numeric steppers (min / max) or a single dual-handle range slider? also how should we surface Burst when the SLO slider is set to Low-latency?
rafa (FE): i lean toward steppers for precision + keyboard, slider for quick tuning. can we combine: slider for visual, small editable number fields for exact values?
keerthi (Design): combo sounds good. for accessibility we need clear labels and aria updates. dual-handle sliders are tricky for a11y — might be better to keep slider visual + two number inputs under the hood.
a11y-bot: reminder: dual-handle sliders have spotty native support and hit testing complexities. recommended pattern: two inputs or two separate slider controls for a11y. see WAI-ARIA range examples.
sam (Eng): runtime note: burst depends on pool capability. UI should gray-out the burst toggle and show a tooltip like `Burst unavailable for selected pool` when not supported.
matt (SRE): also think about guardrails — if user chooses very aggressive SLO (low ms), we should warn and maybe disable burst to avoid sudden QoS spikes. display a clear warning banner.
keerthi (Design): copy suggestion: change label from `Burst` to `Burst capacity (short-term)` and SLO slider tooltip to `Lower latency → higher baseline capacity may be required.`
rafa (FE): keyboard/interaction notes: focus order = Min input -> Max input -> Slider -> Burst toggle. arrow keys increment by 1 GPU, shift+arrow = 5. need visible focus ring for all states.
elaine (PM): can we mock 2 variants for quick testing? Variant A = slider + two inline inputs + burst toggle. Variant B = two steppers only + burst inline. need a11y scan + copy pass.
a11y-bot: proposed aria snippet for Variant A:
``
<input aria-label="Minimum GPUs" id="min-gpus" />
<input aria-label="Maximum GPUs" id="max-gpus" />
<button aria-pressed="false" id="burst-toggle">Burst</button>
```
also add `aria-describedby` linking to hint text and use `aria-live` for capacity changes.
keerthi (Design): i'll produce mocks by EOD. @rafa can you prototype keyboard interactions? @sam can you check pool capability mapping?
rafa (FE): on it — i'll include keyboard prototypes and a11y notes (focus order, screen reader labels)
sam (Eng): i'll add a `supports_burst: true|false` flag to pool metadata and surface `reason` strings in the API so UI can show tooltips.
elaine (PM): microcopy tweak: update `Min`/`Max` to `Min GPUs` / `Max GPUs` and add inline help `Set min to ensure baseline throughput`. also add small help link `Why min matters`.
matt (SRE): :thumbsup: also request: emit audit log events when users change burst or SLO guardrails for compliance.
rafa (FE): quick question — should the SLO slider be linear or logarithmic? some customers think in 1–10ms, others in 10–100ms.
keerthi (Design): show presets (Low latency, Balanced, Cost optimized) as primary. advanced users can toggle to raw ms slider. presets prevent confusion and keep the UI approachable.
elaine (PM): great — we'll run 5 moderated usability sessions next week with both variants. thanks everyone, ping here if any other nits.
